section.title: Web fetch
section.subtitle: Limits for reading one specific page; fetches carry no sign-in credentials
field.maxChars.label: Body limit per fetch (characters)
field.maxChars.help: Upper bound on the Markdown body handed to the model; anything past it is cut. The default 100,000 characters is roughly 25,000 tokens.
field.timeoutSec.label: Timeout per fetch (seconds)
field.timeoutSec.help: When it expires the fetch is abandoned and the model is told the site was too slow.
field.test.label: Test fetch of example.com
field.test.help: Runs one real fetch of example.com; the reply shows the status code and body length, or why it failed.
save.badChars: The body limit must be a number.
save.badTimeout: The timeout must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.ok: It works: HTTP {code}, body converted to {chars} characters.
